v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Benígne fac, Dómine, * in bona voluntáte tua Sion.
text.en: In thy good will, O Lord, * deal favourably with Sion.

text.la: Rectus Dóminus, * Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.
text.en: The Lord our God is righteous * and there is no iniquity in him.

text.la: A timóre inimíci * éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.
text.en: Deliver my soul, * O Lord, from the fear of the enemy.

text.la: In servis suis * miserébitur Dóminus et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
text.en: The Lord will judge * his servants, and will have mercy on the people of his land.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.
text.en: Praise ye the Lord * according to the excellence of his greatness.

text.la: Veníte, mittámus lignum in panem eius, et eradámus eum de terra vivéntium, et nomen eius non memorétur ámplius.
text.en: Come, let us put wood on his bread, and cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: Clarífica me, Pater, * apud temetípsum claritáte, quam hábui priúsquam mundus fíeret.
text.en: Father, glorify Thou Me * with thine Own Self, with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

text.la: Profíciat, quǽsumus, Dómine, plebs tibi dicáta, piæ devotiónis afféctu: ut sacris actiónibus erudíta, quanto maiestáti tuæ fit grátior, tanto donis potióribus augeátur.
text.en: Grant, O Lord, that thy people, which are consecrated to thy service may continually increase in all godly affections: that they being duly instructed in all holy learning, may both be made the more acceptable unto thy divine majesty, and prospered more abundantly in the gifts of thy bounty.
